title: Cargo Liability, CargoCare and Cargo Claims: minimum premium floor and final rounding of the premium charged
content:
## Scope

This rule of the Cargo Liability, CargoCare and Cargo Claims product line fixes the minimum below which the premium charged on a bound cover may not fall, and the single point at which the premium is rounded.

## Rule

1. The premium after the uplift and the discount is raised to the higher of two minimums: the product's minimum premium per container multiplied by the cover's container count, and the product's minimum premium per cover.
2. Only this final figure is rounded to the cent.

## Hypothetical worked examples

Hypothetical minimums: 40.00 USD per container and 90.00 USD per cover, on a three-container cover. The higher minimum is 40.00 multiplied by 3, which is 120.00, against 90.00: 120.00.

| Premium after uplift and discount | Higher minimum | Premium charged |
|---|---|---|
| 246.91356 | 120.00 | 246.91 |
| 80.40 | 120.00 | 120.00 |

## Wrong reading and correct basis

- *Wrong reading:* add the two minimums together, 120.00 and 90.00 making 210.00. *Correct basis:* only the higher of the two minimums applies.
- *Wrong reading:* round the base premium and the gross premium along the way. *Correct basis:* only the final figure is rounded.
